by: builder-judge, by hand from the evidence files, before any model answer
item: One invalid field in a submission that shows some text written by the site (an appeared text or a field description). Submissions whose fields have only the browser's own message, and submissions with no invalid field, are not asked and not labelled here; they are listed under notAsked.
rule: identified (3.3.1): text the site wrote after the empty submit says that this field is wrong, by naming it or by being its own message or description (also the only message of a one-field form). suggested (3.3.3): that text says what to do about this field (fill it in, it is required, enter an e-mail, choose a topic). The browser's own message does not count. null: a person cannot tell from the evidence.
